title: Tom Cruise Pulls Out ‘Risky Business’ Dance Moves for ‘Jennifer Hudson Show’ Spirit Tunnel
content:
ByAngelique Jackson

Tom Cruisepulled out his “Risky Business” dance moves (and those black Ray-Ban sunglasses) for his much-anticipated walk down “TheJennifer HudsonShow’s” Spirit Tunnel.

The talk show appearance is Cruise’s latest stop on the press tour for “Digger,” directed by two-time Academy Award-winning filmmaker Alejandro González Iñárritu. In herVarietyPower of Women cover story, Hudson revealed she booked the movie star as a guest during a change meeting this summer at the World Cup final.

“I was like, ‘Tom, could you imagine your Spirit Tunnel? What do you think they’re going to sing for you?’” Hudson said, shooting her shot.

For the uninitiated: the “Jennifer Hudson Show’s” spirit tunnel is a pre-show segment where her staff lines a hallway at Warner Bros.’ Studio 1 and sings a customized song to welcome each celebrity guest to the stage. Fortunately for Hudson, Cruise knew what he’d be signing up for — “I watch the show, Jennifer,” he told her. “I watch everything. I watched you on ‘American Idol.’” — and, as a new clip shows, he came ready to boogie.

The video, posted to social media on Tuesday, shows Cruise exiting the dressing room to find “The Jennifer Hudson Show” staff rocking black sunglasses and singing a riff on the classic, “Old Time Rock & Roll.”

The song calls back to one of Cruise’s first movie star-making moments from the 1983 movie “Risky Business,” where he slides into frame to lip-sync and dance in his underwear and shades to Bob Seger’s version of the song.

Here, the talk show producers remix the lyrics to reference Cruise’s status as a cinema legend: “We’ve got Tom Cruise at the Happy Place. He’s in the tunnel walking to the stage,” the crew sings. “He’s a legend everybody knows. We’ve got that Tom Cruise rock and roll.”

Cruise quickly commits to the bit, pulling out his own black sunglasses and dancing along, even pulling in some staffers to join him. (Sure, some of his hand claps are off-beat, but Cruise is just as gleefully game here as he is to doing his own stunts in the “Mission: Impossible” movies.)

Likewise, “Digger,” in theaters Friday, is a massive test of Cruise’s dedication. In the film, he plays Digger Rockwell, a Texas oil tycoon whose company may have set off an ecological disaster that could also spark a nuclear war. The role required Cruise to transform with prosthetics (including a fat suit and thinning white hair) and a put-on Southern accent, but, mostly, the absurdist satire demanded his full acting range. The result is a theatrical showcase seemingly crafted to put Cruise back in the competitive Oscar race for the first time in decades.

“I have never had something that could challenge me in this way, and neither has Alejandro,” Cruise said about starring in the black comedy.

The Warner Bros. movie is a big swing, and reviews have been wide-ranging (includingVariety’s), so the studio has gone on offense, confronting the negative buzzwith a new adthat includes both positive and negative reactions, inviting moviegoers to “decide for yourself.”

Viewers have to wait until Wednesday to see Cruise’s full interview, but watch his full Spirit Tunnel performance in the clip below:
title_zh: 湯姆·克魯斯(Tom Cruise)在《珍妮佛·哈德森秀》(The Jennifer Hudson Show)的精神隧道中重現《危險生意》(Risky Business)的舞蹈動作。
content_zh:
安琪莉克·傑克森(Angelique Jackson)報導

湯姆·克魯斯(Tom Cruise)在《珍妮佛·哈德森秀》(The Jennifer Hudson Show)的靈魂隧道中，展現了他的“危險生意”(Risky Business)舞步（以及那副黑色的Ray-Ban太陽眼鏡），引發了大家的期待。

這次脫口秀的出現是克魯斯在為由兩次奧斯卡獲獎導演亞歷杭德羅·岡薩雷斯·伊納里圖(Alejandro González Iñárritu)執導的電影《挖掘者》(Digger)進行宣傳巡演的最新一站。在她的《綜藝》(Variety)《女性力量》(Power of Women)封面故事中，哈德森透露她在今夏的世界盃決賽期間，預約了這位電影明星作為嘉賓。

“我當時想，‘湯姆，你能想像你的靈魂隧道嗎？你覺得他們會為你唱什麼？’”哈德森說，抓住這個機會。

對於不熟悉的人來說：《珍妮佛·哈德森秀》的靈魂隧道是一個預演環節，她的工作人員在華納兄弟(Warner Bros.)的1號攝影棚裡排成一行，為每位明星嘉賓唱一首定制的歌曲以歡迎他們上台。對於哈德森來說，幸運的是，克魯斯知道他將要參加的內容——“我有在看這個節目，珍妮佛，”他告訴她。“我看所有的節目。我在《美國偶像》(American Idol)上看過你。”——而且，正如新影片所顯示的，他準備好要一起舞動。

這段視頻於週二在社交媒體上發布，顯示克魯斯走出化妝間，看到《珍妮佛·哈德森秀》的工作人員戴著黑色太陽眼鏡，唱著經典歌曲《舊時搖滾與滾動》(Old Time Rock & Roll)的改編版本。

這首歌讓人回想起克魯斯在1983年電影《危險生意》中成為電影明星的瞬間，他在鏡頭前滑入畫面，對著Bob Seger的版本進行口型同步和舞蹈，身穿內褲和太陽眼鏡。

在這裡，脫口秀的製作人重新編排了歌詞，以提及克魯斯作為電影傳奇的地位：“我們有湯姆·克魯斯在快樂之地。他在隧道中走向舞台，”工作人員唱道。“他是大家都知道的傳奇。我們有那個湯姆·克魯斯的搖滾與滾動。”

克魯斯迅速投入其中，拿出自己的黑色太陽眼鏡，隨著音樂舞動，甚至拉著一些工作人員一起參與。（當然，他的手拍有些不合拍，但克魯斯在這裡的快樂程度，與他在《不可能的任務》(Mission: Impossible)系列中做特技時一樣。）

同樣，電影《挖掘者》將於週五上映，這是對克魯斯奉獻精神的巨大考驗。在影片中，他飾演德州石油大亨迪格·洛克威爾(Digger Rockwell)，他的公司可能引發了一場生態災難，這也可能引發核戰爭。這個角色要求克魯斯透過假體（包括胖子服和稀疏的白髮）以及模仿南方口音來轉變，但最重要的是，這部荒誕的諷刺喜劇要求他展現全方位的演技。結果是一場似乎專為讓克魯斯再次回到競爭奧斯卡的舞台而精心打造的戲劇展示，這是幾十年來的第一次。

“我從未有過這樣能挑戰我的東西，亞歷杭德羅也沒有，”克魯斯談到參演這部黑色喜劇時說。

華納兄弟(Warner Bros.)的電影是一個大膽的嘗試，評論也各有不同（包括《綜藝雜誌》(Variety)的評價），因此該公司採取了主動，透過一則新的廣告來對抗負面評價，廣告中包含了正面和負面的反應，邀請觀眾「自己來決定」。

觀眾需要等到星期三才能看到湯姆·克魯斯(Tom Cruise)的完整訪談，但可以在下面的片段中觀看他完整的精神隧道表演：
